WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 18 (2 days ago)): Ryan added Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI) for $1 FAAB (dropped Michael Carter (RB, TEN)).

WEEK 10 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Wingard, 141.2-105.7; Adam def. Fronge, 162.0-125.3; Mitchum def. Drew, 134.0-69.0 (BLOWOUT); Jake def. Charles, 180.5-176.4 (NAIL-BITER); Kevin def. Ryan, 137.6-133.8 (NAIL-BITER); Shaq def. Brent, 107.0-76.5

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: TRANSACTION: Mitchum released Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF) today. Deepwater has now cut Robinson and Pierce in the same window while sitting at $104.54 on the exchange and facing Wingard on the road. Trimming depth mid-week is a quiet signal that the active roster is locked. Mitchum is not experimenting — they are executing.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: FRONGE IS UP 39.8-8.8 ON KEVIN RIGHT NOW AND NOBODY IN THIS BUILDING IS TALKING ABOUT IT. REDLINE SOLD 2027 PICKS TO BUY NOVEMBER. NOVEMBER IS CURRENTLY LOSING BY THIRTY-ONE POINTS TO A TEAM THAT MOVED TO HAVANA.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I had Kevin over Fronge as my week 11 lean and I am watching a 39.8-8.8 live score and I am choosing not to panic because it is early and because Redline has done this before — gone down early and clawed back. That is my story and the game is not over.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Adam over Fronge last week before anyone was comfortable with it, and now Adam is sitting at 13.9-0.0 on Corbishley in week 11 — same roster, same logic, same result developing in real time. At some point this stops being contrarian and starts being a methodology.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The live Fronge-Kevin score is exactly the scenario I described when I called Kevin the most fragile 13-5 I have ever ranked. I did not say he would lose. I said the floor was closer than the record suggested. The floor is currently visible from space.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Three teams tied at 15-5. One of them is currently trailing Shaq 0.0-3.9. The Ledger does not write itself — it just sometimes hands you the first paragraph before the first quarter is finished.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: I am 8-4 on the season and I need someone to give me a segment where I go through every game Terrence has missed and explain, in order, exactly why each one was preventable. I have notes. I have been keeping notes since week three.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: The Fronge live score is unexpected and I am going to need everyone asking about my Kevin lean to allow the full game to be played before rendering a verdict. That is a reasonable request and I stand by it completely.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Ryan is up 3.2-0.0 on Brent and the defending champion is a 9-11 team trying to stay out of the cellar bracket while the exchange has him at $124.14. The gap between the stock price and the standings is the whole Aegis story in one number.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Drew is losing to Jake 0.0-4.0 early and the most notable thing about it is that Drew has now trailed at kickoff in what feels like every single game this season. The 0-20 record does not lie about how that habit resolves.
